name: statusline
description: An open-source status line for Claude Code. Installs the latest release binary on session start and enables it if you have no status line.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: A built-in theme. "default" means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

theme_file.title: Theme file
theme_file.description: Path to your own theme file. Overrides Theme when set. Empty means use Theme.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Segments to show, in order, one per entry. Empty means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Glyph drawn between segments. Empty means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Icon set for segment labels: none for plain text, nerd for Nerd Font icons (needs a Nerd Font as your terminal font). "default" means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

path_strip.title: Path prefixes to strip
path_strip.description: Directory prefixes removed from the path; a leading ~ means your home directory. Empty means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

path_worktrees.title: Worktree directories
path_worktrees.description: Directories that hold git worktrees, collapsed to the repository name. Empty means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

path_branch.title: Show git branch
path_branch.description: Show the git branch after the path. "default" means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

path_emoji.title: Show branch emoji
path_emoji.description: Show the theme's emoji before the branch. "default" means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

model_effort.title: Show effort level
model_effort.description: Show the effort level after the model name. "default" means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

snapshot_enabled.title: Save usage snapshot
snapshot_enabled.description: Save the latest session payload for other tools to read. "default" means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.

snapshot_path.title: Usage snapshot path
snapshot_path.description: Where to save the usage snapshot. Empty means use config.yaml, else the built-in default.
